messages:
Alex Rivera: Hey team — heads up I'm officially requesting parental leave starting Sep 12 for ~10 weeks. My custody schedule means I need to be back part-time after 6 weeks. Can we confirm how to set up a phased return + remote days? @Jules (People Ops) @Samira
Jules (People Ops): Congrats Alex! :tada: We support phased returns. Can you DM me your anticipated FTE on return? Also please fill the parental_leave form: https://redwood.company/hr/forms/parental-leave
Samira Khan: Quick Q — will benefits continue during reduced FTE? Need to know for childcare elig.
Jules (People Ops): Benefits are prorated for payroll top-ups but core medical/dental/vision remain active during leave. I'll post a short breakdown in a sec.
HR Bot: [Automated] Parental leave checklist uploaded: /hr/policies/parental_leave_checklist.pdf. Remember to attach FMLA docs if applicable.
Tom H: I can cover your oncall during weeks 1–6. @Alex remind me of the infra playbooks and runbook links.
Alex Rivera: thanks Tom!! I'll add runbook links below.
Alex Rivera: runbook snippet:
```
Oncall steps:
1. Check cluster health dashboard (link in 1Password)
2. If p99 latency > 500ms, escalate to eng-sre channel @eng-sre
3. For model-serving errors, restart worker pool and open a pager if >3 failures in 10m
```
Laura M: I can take two interviews during week 3 and 4, and help finish the handoff docs.
Jules (People Ops): Next steps: 1) Fill the parental_leave form 2) Submit FMLA paperwork to benefits@redwood.com 3) Confirm coverage plan (names + responsibilities) 4) Decide phased return schedule by Aug 25 so payroll/benefits can be set.
Alex Rivera: I'll fill the form tonight. Proposed phased return: week 7 onwards = 60% time (2 in-office days, 3 remote). Custody constraint: every Tue morning off for pickups. Is that OK operationally?
Samira Khan: Also checking about childcare subsidy — how do we apply? Is it pre-approved for partial returns?
Jules (People Ops): Childcare subsidy: submit request to people-ops@redwood.com with expected receipts. Typically needs submission 30 days before leave start; exceptions exist. For your case I can waive the deadline if you send docs by Sep 5. Subsidy amount is fixed per month; prorated for partial FTE.
Alex Rivera: Appreciate that, Jules. One admin Q: do I need to return my company laptop while on leave? I'll be traveling a bit.
Jules (People Ops): No, keep your device while on leave. We only collect devices for long-duration role changes or contractor exits. Please ensure disk encryption is enabled and 2FA is active.
Tom H: Noted — I've added Alex's oncall coverage to the rota and linked the runbook.
Jules (People Ops): I updated the people-ops tracker with proposed dates and assigned coverage owners. I'll confirm payroll top-up % with Finance tomorrow and DM you the numbers.
Alex Rivera: perfect, thank you everyone. I'll post the final filled form and custody docs here once done. :heart:
HR Bot: [Automated] Thread archived in People Ops: parental leave coordination.
